'''''Algebra: Chapter 0''''' is a graduate [[abstract algebra]] textbook written by [[Paolo Aluffi]]. The book was first published in 2009 by the [[American Mathematical Society]] and is now a common choice in introductory courses in abstract algebra.<ref>{{cite web |title=Textbooks Department of Mathematics |url=https://math.cornell.edu/textbooks |website=math.cornell.edu |access-date=21 June 2025 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Smith |first1=Karen |title=Math 593: Graduate Algebra I |url=https://sites.lsa.umich.edu/kesmith/teaching/math-593-graduate-algebra-i/ |website=umich.edu |date=13 June 2024 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Algebra (470-1-61) |url=https://class-descriptions.northwestern.edu/5000/WCAS/MATH/13216 |website=northwestern.edu |access-date=2025-06-21 |archive-date=2025-06-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250621155934/https://class-descriptions.northwestern.edu/5000/WCAS/MATH/13216 |url-status=live }}</ref>

==History==

''Algebra: Chapter 0'' was published by the [[American Mathematical Society]]'s as part of their ''Graduate Studies in Mathematics'' series.<ref name="AMS">{{cite web |title=Algebra: Chapter 0 |url=https://www.ams.org/books/gsm/104/ |website=American Mathematical Society |language=en |date=15 July 2009}}</ref> The book was well-received and an updated second printing was published in 2016.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Berg |first1=Michael |title=MAA Reviews Algebra: Chapter 0 |url=https://old.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/algebra-chapter-0 |website=old.maa.org |publisher=Mathematical Association of America |access-date=21 June 2025 |date=17 September 2009 |archive-date=21 June 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250621155932/https://old.maa.org/press/maa-reviews/algebra-chapter-0 |url-status=live }}</ref>

The book began as a transcript of Aluffi's lectures at [[Florida State University]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Aluffi |first1=Paolo |title=Algebra: Chapter 0 |date=2009 |publisher=American Mathematical Society |location=Providence (R.I.) |isbn=978-0-8218-4781-7 |page=xviii |edition=First |language=en}}</ref>

Aluffi maintains an extensive list of errata on his Florida State University webpage.<ref>{{cite web |title=Aluffi's FSU webpage |url=https://www.math.fsu.edu/~aluffi |website=math.fsu.edu |access-date=11 November 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

==Content==
The book aims to be a fully self-contained introduction to [[abstract algebra]] for advanced undergraduates and beginning graduates. The main distinguishing factor of the book from other algebra texts is its early introduction to [[Category (mathematics)|categories]] which remain relevant throughout the book. It also features a greater emphasis on [[homological algebra]].<ref name="AMS"/>
